parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.value: ={{ 'recovery:' + $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id + ':' + ($('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id, $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.version, $json.status === 'succeeded' ? 'recovered' : 'cancelled'] }}

parameters.query: WITH attempt AS (INSERT INTO retry_attempts (recovery_case_id, attempt_number, provider_idempotency_key, status, finished_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, 'succeeded', now()) ON CONFLICT (recovery_case_id, attempt_number) DO NOTHING) SELECT mark_recovery_terminal($1::uuid, $4, 'recovered')

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id, $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1, 'recovery:' + $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id + ':' + ($('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1), $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.version] }}

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error_code: $json.last_payment_error?.code, decline_code: $json.last_payment_error?.decline_code, advice_code: $json.last_payment_error?.advice_code, attempts_completed: $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1, occurred_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

parameters.query: WITH attempt AS (INSERT INTO retry_attempts (recovery_case_id, attempt_number, provider_idempotency_key, status, provider_error_code, finished_at) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, 'failed', $4, now()) ON CONFLICT (recovery_case_id, attempt_number) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) UPDATE recovery_cases SET attempts_completed = attempts_completed + 1, status = CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN 'pending' WHEN $6::boolean THEN 'manual_review' ELSE 'exhausted' END, next_retry_at = $7::timestamptz, max_attempts = $8, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid AND version = $9 AND status = 'attempting' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempt)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id, $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1, 'recovery:' + $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.id + ':' + ($('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.attempts_completed + 1), $('Confirm with Idempotency Key').item.json.last_payment_error?.decline_code ?? $('Confirm with Idempotency Key').item.json.last_payment_error?.code ?? 'unknown', $json.retry_allowed, $json.manual_review_required, $json.next_retry_at, $json.max_attempts, $('Atomically Claim Due Retries').item.json.version] }}
